day_shape: 58 items dominated by Iran regime-channel Arbaeen logistics and Araghchi diplomacy (Oman, Pakistan, Najaf), IDF says it killed PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair in Deir al-Balah, Trump calls Iran leadership 'duplicitous', two more political prisoner executions reported; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Araghchi regional diplomacy and Arbaeen visit
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-linked channels reported FM Abbas Araghchi held phone calls with Oman's al-Busaidi and received a formal Pakistani invitation to visit Islamabad, while travelling to Najaf for Arbaeen. Defa Press and IRIB also reported a Pezeshkian–Hamas leadership call and disputed Trump's claim that US–Iran talks would begin Monday, citing Pakistani officials saying no date is set.

threads.label: Arbaeen pilgrimage logistics
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted extensive coverage of Arbaeen operations, including police commander Radan's figure of over 3.26 million pilgrims having left Iran with more than one million still in Iraq, and the deployment of 10 Iranian headquarters and eight committees in Iraq. Tehran Metro extended service from 5am, fruit and vegetable bazaars closed, and medical staff were reported deployed round-the-clock along the march route.

threads.label: Gaza strike, ceasefire strain and Board of Peace
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair, accused of holding hostage Rom Braslavski, in a Deir al-Balah strike, while Board of Peace Director-General Nickolay Mladenov travelled to Israel and reportedly requested a halt to IDF strikes to begin Hamas demilitarisation. Turkey accused Netanyahu's government of undermining ceasefire efforts, Hamas said Israeli aggression was disrupting the agreement, and a claim attributed to Jared Kushner about halting attacks was later retracted.

threads.label: US–Iran pressure track and Hormuz posture
threads.summary: Trump publicly called Iran's leadership 'unbelievably duplicitous' over the state of talks, and the Jerusalem Post reported CENTCOM had asked analysts for 'creative and unconventional' ways to pressure Tehran. Defa Press said Majles figures reasserted Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz following US and UK statements, and IRIB claimed US strategic crude reserves had fallen to their lowest level since 1983.

threads.label: Iran domestic hardship and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iran hanged two more political prisoners early Monday on charges of 'spying and intelligence cooperation with Israel', extending a wave of national-security executions. A separate Iran International piece, citing ILNA, reported households selling hair and empty perfume bottles and renting laptops amid deepening economic hardship.

Donald Trump's hesitation to expand war with Iran has revealed an important strategic problem for Washington and Tel Aviv: air defence interceptor missiles are being consumed faster than they can be produced and replaced.
events.summary_en: Haaretz: The main problem is interceptor missiles, not anything else!.... Trump understands the cost of his war! Donald Trump's hesitation to expand war with Iran has revealed an important strategic problem for Washington and Tel Aviv: air defence interceptor missiles are being consumed faster than they can be produced and replaced. Continued engagement has also depleted reserves of short- and medium-range missile defence systems such as Patriot available to the United States, Israel and other regional allies. According to this analysis, the fewer interceptor missiles there are, the more difficult and costly protracted war with Iran would be for the United States and Israel; a cost that Trump now views more seriously than before.
